decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording detailed shot descriptions and optional online example frames; no additional update or removal is required.
The source concerns reference materials for shots that deviate from the storyboard, not the separate character-detail and artistic-style reference images.
Using detailed descriptions or example frames to communicate shot direction does not change the existing permissions to adjust angles or regenerate sets for image quality.
The source changes how storyboard deviations may be communicated but does not alter the specified CC1 shot pairs or framing progression.
The communication method for storyboard deviations does not change the inclusion or deferred status of the opening aerial establishing shot.
